description: The Aberdovey to Barmouth section of the Wales Coast Path is a scenic walk that takes you along the coast, offering views of the Dyfi Estuary and Snowdonia National Park. The path follows a generally easy route with sections that climb high into the coastal hills of Snowdonia, and also visits the various towns and villages along the way.
